action: state why the 3,958 zombies cannot be reaped from inside the container, and what would
evidence: finding PR-11. A zombie is already dead; only its PARENT calling wait() releases the PID slot, and no signal to a zombie does anything. All of them have PPid 1, which in this container is `sleep infinity` -- a shell builtin blocked in sleep that never calls wait(). So nothing inside the container, in any namespace, can reap them. Fixes, none applied: a reaping PID 1 (tini/dumb-init, or `bash -c 'while :; do wait -n; done'`), the spawner reaping its own children, or a container restart which clears all at once. Recorded as a post-cleanup decision for the user
